notes.title: March 2025 Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
This is the first major update for Brass Necessity since it's original Early Access release. We've re-focused the game in the direction we initially envisioned and are working to add the remaining areas to the game.

Brass Necessity is a completely community/volunteer-made game. So if you have ideas or feedback, be sure to let us know! We want to make the game the most fun we can for the community.

[previewyoutube=-OPwrLJYtMM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]New Features and Content
[/h1]
[list]
[*] The current game has been broken into 3 separate levels, with three new areas  
[list]
[*] Mining Outpost  
[*] The Cursed Sanctuary  
[*] Abandoned Castle  [/list]
[*] Additional enemy types in the Cave In and Abandoned Castle levels  
[*] Laser-based puzzle requiring the correct crystal  
[*] Enclosed enemy battles  
[*] Laser explosion deals damages to the player and nearby enemies  
[*] Other playable characters appear as NPCs in The Cursed Sanctuary  
[list]
[*]  Dialog changes based on progress  
[*]  Dialog varies depending on the playable character  [/list]
[*] Progress is saved when completing levels  
[list]
[*] Each playable character has their own progress  
[*] Levels are repeatable even after beating[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies deal more damage  
[*] Enemies have improved speed/balance  
[*] Improved scene lighting and atmosphere  
[*] Added additional models and details to environments  
[*] Improved player movement speed  
[*] Simplified and improved player controls  
[*] Simplified crystal-type matchups  
[*] Re-focused levels to fewer crystal types  
[*] Updated level transition screens
[/list]
[h1]Fixes
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed settings save feature  
[*] Fixed bug where player could use the reload key to reset the laser overheat level to zero  
[*] Fixed issues with multiple music tracks playing at once
[*] Various other minor fixes
[/list]
[h1]All changes[/h1]
For a full list of changes, be sure to check out [url=https://github.com/poppedcornbytes/BrassNecessity]the game's GitHub page[/url].
